jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are: Umbrella makes software that helps banks, fintechs and marketplaces catch financial crime. Our platform gives risk teams one view of device, identity and payment signals so they can stop fraud as it happens, block automated attacks, and run their compliance work with less manual effort.

Our culture:

  • We hire capable, self-directed people who take real ownership of outcomes.

  • We measure results rather than hours, and we do not ask anyone to skip the moments that matter outside work for the sake of a rigid schedule.

  • We are remote and spread across time zones, with no office to commute to. Pay depends on where you live, and you need to live in the country that employs you, so the flexibility is within your country, not across borders.

LOCATION:

  • Remote - United States or Canada

About the Role

As Umbrella signs larger customers, our delivery process has to meet the program management standards those customers are used to, with formal governance, named owners and reporting they can predict, while still moving at startup speed. You will run the integration plan for complex enterprise rollouts with many stakeholders: milestones, dependencies, timeline, and the customer's product requests, all the way to resolution, maintained hand in hand with the customer. You will keep engineering, product and our solutions engineers working from one critical path, and you will report candidly on what is late and why. You will also establish a RACI and a communication rhythm on every engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integration plan for each enterprise rollout, including milestones, dependencies and the implementation timeline.

  • Be the customer's main point of contact during integration: communicate often, raise risks early, and understand their requirements in depth.

  • Follow every customer feature request from intake to resolution so nothing filed with engineering or product goes quiet.

  • Agree roles and responsibilities at the start of each engagement so ownership is clear to both sides.

  • Keep a steady, structured cadence with the customer and with our own engineering, product and integrations teams, and set expectations before they become problems.

  • Keep deliverables organized, current and owned.

  • Learn the product deeply enough to be a real partner on feature requests, not a relay for status.

  • Report on project health: slipped deliverables and their causes, dependency risk, and capacity across concurrent rollouts.

What You'll Bring

  • Seven or more years managing technical programs or projects, including enterprise implementations.

  • Experience meeting a large customer's formal governance expectations, and the judgment to scale that rigor down for smaller customers.

  • A background in financial crime, risk, payments or other fintech work, preferably selling B2B software to large companies.

  • Enough technical depth to discuss dependencies and tradeoffs with engineers and help them prioritize.

  • Clear writing and speaking, including turning technical status into language executives trust.

  • The organization to run several high-stakes engagements at once without dropping details.

Benefits

  • Competitive cash and equity

  • Early exercise on options

  • Remote-first work

  • Flexible time off and a year-end break

  • Medical, dental and vision for you and your dependents (US and Canada)

  • Retirement matching (US and Canada)

  • A laptop shipped to you

  • A home office setup stipend

  • Monthly meal, social and wellness stipends

  • An annual learning budget

We are growing quickly and want to meet you. Our applicant privacy notice explains how we handle your personal information: https://example.com/privacy.
